abi.return_al: true only when the earned key was newly inserted; independent of whether its date was written

contract.earned_key_insert: Calls145acb580 before examining date-enabled. Existing key returnsfalse; absent key is inserted in lexicographic order and returnstrue.
contract.date_gate: 145ac2ac1 tests returned_new_key & date_enabled; ifzero, returns without touching dates.
contract.date_insert: For a new dated key, binary-searches32B date rows; an existing exact key returns without replacing its timestamp, otherwise inserts the supplied timestamp atrow+0x18.
contract.legacy_undated: Already-earned keys remain undated even when later delivered with a date.
contract.repeat_delivery: Repeated grants returnfalse and preserve earned/date records.
contract.undated_new: A newly inserted key with date_enabled=false is retained without creating a date.
contract.new_key_existing_date: A newly inserted earned key with an existing date returns true but preserves the date.
contract.timestamp_domain: Copies all supplied64bits, including0; clock acquisition/conversion belongs to callers.

earned_set.interface: Save+a8/b0/b8 sorted24B key vector; existing-equal returns0 at145acb6cd, absent insertion returns1 at145acb73b. No surrounding collection-engine reconstruction.

save_boundary.scope: Owning account-save boundary called by the grant wrappers. This bounded task neither reimplements nor certifies its envelope, backups or filesystem behavior; existing Save::write remains the established source interface.

source_connection.correspondence: BTreeSet::insert skips existing keys; optional earned_at stamps only new keys; dates.entry(key).or_insert(seconds) preserves existing dates; returnedVec contains newly inserted keys only. Comparison concerns valid nativecatalogkeys supplied by the recovered callers.
source_connection.persistence_boundary: MenuState::commit_account ordered save snapshot -> Save::write is owned by existing save/account implementation; caller ordering is separately recovered.

limits: Static branch tracing cases, not executed Rust or original-instruction fixtures.
